appearances.whereabouts: Stedding Tsofu, guiding the group to the Elders and then to the Waygate
appearances.notable_actions: Guides Rand's party to the Elders, summons Trayal at Alar's command, brings their horses, shows obvious nervousness around the Waygate
appearances.demeanor: dutiful but anxious, especially near the Waygate

appearances.whereabouts: Stedding Tsofu, meeting with the Elders and at the Waygate
appearances.notable_actions: Argues for Loial to accompany them, recognizes Machin Shin when the Waygate opens, shouts warning to close it, commits to finding the Portal Stone, internally wrestles with fear and eagerness about channeling
appearances.demeanor: protective of friends, anxious about using the Power, determined despite fear

appearances.whereabouts: Stedding Tsofu, outside the Elders' mound reading, then accompanying the group
appearances.notable_actions: Waits nervously outside while others meet Elders, tries to appear occupied with reading, discusses Erith's flower, explains Waygate locations, shows relief when the Waygate cannot be used but also shame at that relief
appearances.demeanor: nervous around Ogier women and the Elders, conflicted about danger versus duty, touched by Erith's attention

appearances.whereabouts: Stedding Tsofu, at the Elders' meeting and the Waygate
appearances.notable_actions: Defends Loial's right to come along, engages in banter with friends, sits with head in hands showing weakness, lifts head hopefully at mention of Portal Stones
appearances.demeanor: joking and irreverent in banter, but physically weakened and ill (drawn face), desperate for the dagger to be recovered

appearances.whereabouts: Stedding Tsofu, at the Elders' meeting and the Waygate
appearances.notable_actions: Explains the group's need to use the Waygate, opens the Waygate with the Avendesora leaf, closes it when Machin Shin appears, discusses Portal Stones and the Ways with the Elders, gives Rand a sidelong glance connecting him to the Black Wind, expresses urgency to move forward
appearances.demeanor: calm and authoritative but shows subtle signs of unease (wipes hands after closing gate), thoughtful and muttering to herself, brisk when a solution appears

appearances.whereabouts: Stedding Tsofu, fetching soldiers and at the Waygate
appearances.notable_actions: Sent by Ingtar to fetch Uno and soldiers, suggests using Portal Stones based on Selene's information, gapes at the Elders
appearances.demeanor: dutiful, increasingly confident when making his suggestion

appearances.whereabouts: Stedding Tsofu, meeting hall of the Elders and leading to the Waygate
appearances.notable_actions: Presides over the council of Elders, explains the dangers of the Ways, has Trayal brought to demonstrate the cost, questions Rand about Loial and ta'veren, gives Rand responsibility for Loial's safety, leads the group to the Waygate, reveals existence of nearby Portal Stone
appearances.demeanor: wise, calm, authoritative, compassionate about Trayal's fate, shudders at nearness of Machin Shin

appearances.whereabouts: Stedding Tsofu, at the Elders' meeting and the Waygate

appearances.demeanor: formal, determined, increasingly frustrated and angry when obstacles appear, calmer than most during the Waygate opening

appearances.demeanor: protective of Mat, good-humored in banter, worried about his friend's health
